list.emptyDescription: Check back soon to redeem your GeoPoints.

redeem.cost: {{points}} pts will be deducted from your balance.
redeem.confirmBody: Confirming generates a QR code that is shown only once: show it at the counter before it expires.
redeem.dismissWarning: Closing makes the QR code disappear for good: it is not stored anywhere and cannot be shown again.
redeem.heldBody: The QR code was shown once and cannot be recovered. You will be able to redeem this reward again once this redemption expires.
redeem.statusError: We couldn't check your redemption status.

terminal.Redeemed: You already used this redemption at the counter.
terminal.Failed: This redemption could not be completed.

error.stockExhausted: This reward is out of stock, so the redemption could not be generated.
error.businessNotActive: The business is not active right now, so it isn't accepting redemptions. Try again once it is back.
error.rewardNotFound: This reward is no longer available.

redemption.instructions: Show this code at the counter to redeem your reward.

rating.hint: Pick 1 to 5. It can only be rated once and cannot be changed afterwards.
rating.thanks: Thanks! You rated this reward {{value}} out of 5.

error.alreadyRated: You already rated this redemption, so there is nothing left to do.
error.notRedeemed: You haven't used this redemption at the counter yet. You will be able to rate it once you do.
error.redemptionNotFound: We couldn't find this redemption, so it can't be rated.
error.notAuthorized: This redemption isn't yours, so you can't rate it.

identityVerification.title: Identity verification pending
identityVerification.body: Redeeming a reward requires a verified identity.
identityVerification.unavailable: You can't start verification from the app yet. Try redeeming the reward again later.
